resources.string: Point the camera at the horizon and turn slowly on the spot. Line up the horizon under the crosshair and tap Mark at regular intervals as you turn.
Mark at least 8 points spread around the full turn before finishing.
Camera permission is required to survey the horizon.
Location is optional. If granted, it is used only to correct compass readings to true north (magnetic declination); it is never stored or exported.
This device has no compass/orientation sensor.
